description: 8 min warm-up; 27 min easy; 5 min cool-down. Low-impact aerobic work next to the running: Mostly steady endurance (RPE 2-3, 56-75 % of FTP if you use power). Eat and drink on rides over 90 minutes.

title: Easy run
description: 5 min warm-up; 20 min easy; 5 min cool-down. Easy means RPE 2-3: you can talk in full sentences. Use your watch's easy heart-rate zone if you have one.

title: Easy run
description: 5 min warm-up; 20 min easy; 5 min cool-down. Easy means RPE 2-3: you can talk in full sentences. Use your watch's easy heart-rate zone if you have one.

title: Activation (20 min easy run + 3 short pickups)
description: 20 min easy with 3 pickups of 15 s at race effort. Pack your kit, check your gear, eat normally, sleep.

title: RACE DAY: Marathon
description: Start easier than feels necessary for the first third. Eat and drink as practised, nothing new. It is a day to enjoy the work you did; no plan can promise a time.
